I am an old man now, 56 years, and I farm here in Mbeya on this small piece of 0.16 hectares where I plant my maize together with beans between the rows. The soil here is still good because Mbeya has rain, but every year the harvest is less if you put nothing, so I buy a small bag of Urea and DAP when the price allows, and I also carry manure from my few animals to spread before planting. I use improved seed from the agrodealer because the local seed gives a poor cob, but I cannot afford pesticide every season — I only weed with my hoe and my wife helps. We do not irrigate, we wait for the rains like always.
